courses.title: Electronics
courses.summary: Circuits, op amps, diodes and transistors, from Ohm's law to working designs.

lockedTrees.title: Digital logic
lockedTrees.note: Gates, flip-flops and counters, built from the transistor switches of Electronics.

lockedTrees.title: Signal processing
lockedTrees.note: Spectra, sampling and filters, built on the impedance, filters and decibels of Circuit analysis.

lockedTrees.title: Particle physics
lockedTrees.note: Electrons, protons and the particles beyond them, and the detectors that track them, such as the spark chamber.

lockedTrees.title: Electromagnetism
lockedTrees.note: Fields, induction and electromagnetic waves, built on the charge, current, capacitors and inductors of the core.

lockedTrees.title: Mathematics
lockedTrees.note: Complex numbers, differential equations and the Laplace and Fourier transforms behind the impedance and time constants of Circuit analysis.

lockedTrees.title: RF
lockedTrees.note: Radio-frequency circuits: transmission lines, impedance matching, amplifiers and antennas, built on the impedance of Circuit analysis and the transistors of Electronics.

lockedTrees.title: Troubleshooting
lockedTrees.note: Finding faults in real circuits with a meter and an oscilloscope, built on the bias points of Electronics and the schematics of the Workshop.
